name: spec-kit-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Spec Kit, GitHub's toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, and its `specify` command-line
tool. This task covers how `specify init` scaffolds a project, how the CLI installs, switches, upgrades, reports and
removes AI coding agent integrations (with the Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and generic integrations as the agent
packages in scope), and the workflow engine that runs, pauses, resumes and composes multi-step workflows.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the specify_cli package: src/specify_cli/__init__.py, _agent_config.py, _assets.py, _init_options.py, _invocation_style.py, _project.py, _toml_string.py, _utils.py, catalogs.py, integration_runtime.py, integration_state.py, integration_status.py and shared_infra.py; src/specify_cli/commands/__init__.py and src/specify_cli/commands/init.py; every module directly in src/specify_cli/integrations/ except _scaffold_commands.py; the claude, codex, copilot, gemini and generic integration packages (src/specify_cli/integrations/<name>/__init__.py); and every module in src/specify_cli/workflows/, including its overlays/ and steps/ subpackages. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/reference/core.md, docs/reference/integrations.md, docs/reference/workflows.md and docs/guides/monorepo.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
